en.headline: Hong Kong face Laos at Kai Tak in FIFA ASEAN Cup
en.dek: The hosts open their Division 2 campaign at 3pm, with Cambodia versus Myanmar to follow at 6pm at Kai Tak Stadium.
body: Hong Kong, China play Laos at 3pm on Sunday at Kai Tak Stadium in their first match of the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup, after two Division 2 fixtures were staged at Mong Kok Stadium on Thursday.

Hong Kong are in Group A with Laos and Brunei Darussalam. Laos beat Brunei 3-1 at Mong Kok on Thursday and sit top of the group. The second Sunday match, Cambodia against Myanmar, kicks off at 6pm at the same ground. Hong Kong next meet Brunei at Kai Tak at 8pm on Wednesday, 30 September.

The Major Sports Events Committee has awarded the tournament M-Mark status. Division 2 group winners meet in a final at Kai Tak at 6pm on Saturday, 3 October. Division 1 matches are being played in Jakarta and Bandung.

Kai Tak Sports Park listed the Sunday kick-off times as 3pm and 6pm. The government said the four Hong Kong match days bring Southeast Asian national teams and the home side together at Mong Kok and Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 東盟盃港隊主場啟德迎戰老撾 下午三時開波
zh.dek: 國際足協東盟盃分組賽周日移師啟德主場館，傍晚六時另有柬埔寨對緬甸。
body: 中國香港代表隊今日下午三時在啟德主場館對老撾，展開國際足協東盟盃分組賽主場首戰。周四兩場分組賽已在旺角大球場舉行。
港隊與老撾、汶萊同處A組。老撾周四在旺角以3比1擊敗汶萊，暫列小組首位。同日傍晚六時，柬埔寨對緬甸亦在啟德主場館上演。港隊下一場將於9月30日晚上八時在啟德對汶萊。
大型體育活動事務委員會已向賽事頒發「M」品牌資格。第二級賽事小組首名將於10月3日晚上六時在啟德爭標；第一級賽事則在印尼雅加達及萬隆舉行。
啟德體育園公布周日開賽時間為下午三時及六時。當局表示，香港四個比賽日將匯集東南亞代表隊及港隊，分別在旺角及啟德作賽。
